method: Complete conservative recursive module import/re-export/import-type/literal-dynamic graph from immutable git tree. Runtime-or-mixed is syntax classification, not emitted import erasure. Root owner/local-declaration references distinguish selected business dependencies from excluded whole-module siblings; lexical references are conservative and do not replace manual symbol/body review. Non-root dependency modules retain full bodies and barrel supersets. Native precode hashes deliberately remain aa4daff54, even while working-tree owner edits proceed.

correspondence.replacement: Named class retains business state and complete branches; native runes/onMount/stable callbacks replace React representation. Canonical shared dependencies remain reused; no unchanged assertion credit.
